description: Workflow identity/version/run and non-executing Task/Action/Event/Handoff persistence.
statements: CREATE TABLE operations.record_state(code text PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO operations.record_state VALUES('DRAFT'),('PENDING'),('RUNNING'),('SUCCEEDED'),('FAILED'),('CANCELLED'),('ARCHIVED')

CREATE TABLE operations.workflow (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), name text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(name)<>''), owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES operations.record_state(code), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE operations.workflow_version (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), business_id uuid NOT NULL, workflow_id uuid NOT NULL, version_number text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(version_number)<>''), definition_reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(definition_reference)<>''), definition_hash text NOT NULL CHECK(definition_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(workflow_id,version_number), UNIQUE(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_id) REFERENCES operations.workflow(business_id,id))
CREATE TRIGGER workflow_version_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON operations.workflow_version FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_history_mutation()

CREATE TABLE operations.workflow_run (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), workflow_version_id uuid NOT NULL, owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, trigger_reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(trigger_reference)<>''), current_stage text, state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' REFERENCES operations.record_state(code), risk_id uuid, approval_id uuid, started_at timestamptz, finished_at timestamptz, FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_version_id) REFERENCES operations.workflow_version(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,risk_id) REFERENCES governance.risk(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,approval_id) REFERENCES governance.approval(business_id,id), CHECK(started_at IS NULL OR finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at>=started_at))

CREATE TABLE operations.task (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), workflow_run_id uuid NOT NULL, owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, objective text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(objective)<>''), priority integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(priority>=0), due_at timestamptz, sla interval CHECK(sla>=interval '0 seconds'), input_reference text, expected_output text, acceptance_criteria text, approval_id uuid, risk_id uuid, blockers text, next_action text, verification_evidence_id uuid, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' REFERENCES operations.record_state(code), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_run_id) REFERENCES operations.workflow_run(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,approval_id) REFERENCES governance.approval(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,risk_id) REFERENCES governance.risk(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,verification_evidence_id) REFERENCES governance.evidence(business_id,id))

CREATE TABLE operations.action (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), task_id uuid NOT NULL, actor_id uuid NOT NULL, capability text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(capability)<>''), intended_side_effect text NOT NULL, permission_result text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_EVALUATED' CHECK(permission_result IN ('NOT_EVALUATED','ALLOW','DENY')), policy_result text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_EVALUATED' CHECK(policy_result IN ('NOT_EVALUATED','ALLOW','DENY')), approval_id uuid, idempotency_key text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(idempotency_key)<>''), execution_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' REFERENCES operations.record_state(code), verification_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNVERIFIED' REFERENCES governance.verification_state(code), retry_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(retry_count>=0), result_reference text, UNIQUE(business_id,idempotency_key), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,task_id) REFERENCES operations.task(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,approval_id) REFERENCES governance.approval(business_id,id))

CREATE TABLE operations.event (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), event_type text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(event_type)<>''), source text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(source)<>''), idempotency_key text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(idempotency_key)<>''), occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL, payload_reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(payload_reference)<>''), severity text, processing_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' REFERENCES operations.record_state(code), UNIQUE(business_id,source,idempotency_key))

CREATE TABLE operations.handoff (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), workflow_run_id uuid NOT NULL, from_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, to_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, context_reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(context_reference)<>''), acceptance_criteria text, accepted_at timestamptz, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' REFERENCES operations.record_state(code), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_run_id) REFERENCES operations.workflow_run(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,from_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,to_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE operations.event_workflow_run (business_id uuid NOT NULL, event_id uuid NOT NULL, workflow_run_id uuid NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(event_id,workflow_run_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,event_id) REFERENCES operations.event(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_run_id) REFERENCES operations.workflow_run(business_id,id))

CREATE TABLE operations.task_dependency(business_id uuid NOT NULL, task_id uuid NOT NULL, depends_on_id uuid NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(task_id,depends_on_id), CHECK(task_id<>depends_on_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,task_id) REFERENCES operations.task(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,depends_on_id) REFERENCES operations.task(business_id,id))

CREATE FUNCTION operations.prevent_rebinding() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE field text; BEGIN FOREACH field IN ARRAY TG_ARGV LOOP IF to_jsonb(NEW)->field IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(OLD)->field THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PINNED_FIELD_CHANGED'; END IF; END LOOP; RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER prevent_rebinding BEFORE UPDATE ON operations.workflow_run FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION operations.prevent_rebinding('workflow_version_id')
CREATE TRIGGER prevent_rebinding BEFORE UPDATE ON operations.task FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION operations.prevent_rebinding('workflow_run_id')

CREATE TRIGGER prevent_rebinding BEFORE UPDATE ON operations.action FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION operations.prevent_rebinding('task_id','actor_id','capability','intended_side_effect','idempotency_key')

CREATE TRIGGER prevent_rebinding BEFORE UPDATE ON operations.event FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION operations.prevent_rebinding('event_type','source','idempotency_key','occurred_at','payload_reference')
CREATE TRIGGER record_initialize BEFORE INSERT ON operations.workflow FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_initialize()

CREATE TRIGGER record_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON operations.task FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER record_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON operations.task FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()
CREATE TRIGGER record_initialize BEFORE INSERT ON operations.action FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_initialize()
CREATE TRIGGER record_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON operations.action FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER record_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON operations.action FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER record_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON operations.action FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()
CREATE TRIGGER record_initialize BEFORE INSERT ON operations.event FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_initialize()
CREATE TRIGGER record_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON operations.event FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER record_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON operations.event FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER record_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON operations.event FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()

CREATE TRIGGER record_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON operations.handoff FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER record_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON operations.handoff FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
